owner_initiated_migration.meaning: the owner initiated the convertToV3 migration transaction

pool_last_trade_age_minutes.meaning: age in minutes of the target pool's last trade at the time of the migration

pool_history_missing.meaning: the target pool is newly created with missing history

history_check_uses_oldest_observation.meaning: the history check uses the actual oldest observation in the buffer to determine whether enough history exists

protocol_funds_lost.meaning: a direct loss of protocol-owned funds occurred as a result of the migration

assumptions: The history check is invoked during the owner-initiated convertToV3 migration.
The oldest observation in the buffer is the report-required basis for determining whether enough history exists.

unresolved.description: The report does not state an observable expected value distinct from the observed history-check behavior; the correspondence pattern cannot express 'check should use the actual oldest observation' as a mismatch between two grounded observables without inventing the expected observation value.
Report does not specify the concrete logic error in the history/observation check beyond 'logic errors', so the observed-vs-expected history-check relation cannot be bound.

limitations: The impact is asserted as a direct loss of protocol-owned funds; the plan does not formalize downstream economic magnitude because the report gives none.
The pool-inactive branch uses the report's 'more than 30 minutes' literal; the newly-created branch is represented by a grounded Boolean because no numeric history threshold is stated.
This claim formalizes only the single frozen intent intent_history_check for direct_loss_of_protocol_owned_funds; other intents are separate claims.
